text: 🇲✊ "We govern for the people and by the people of Mexico. That will not change — because we have principles and causes." "I didn't become president just to arrive and say 'that's enough.' We came to keep fighting for the people — because from the presidency, you lead the people's struggle." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Teapa, Tabasco

🇲🌎 "Mexico is no one's colony. We are no one's protectorate. Mexico — with great honor and pride — is a free, independent, and sovereign country." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Teapa, Tabasco Sheinbaum in Tabasco delivering welfare programs ahead of her May 31 national accountability report — broadcast live across all 32 state capitals to mark two years since winning the presidency.

🇲🇽🏗️ President meets the workers building southern Mexico's infrastructure. — Macuspana-Escárcega highway site, Tabasco The highway includes the Pozo Azul and Agua Blanca bridges, interchanges, and bus stops. When complete, it will cut travel times across three states and open Tabasco's production to the Yucatán Peninsula.

🇲🇽🚧 Sheinbaum inspects Macuspana-Escárcega highway expansion — 250 km, 4 lanes, connecting Tabasco, Campeche, and Chiapas. — Macuspana, Tabasco $21 billion peso investment. 34,000 jobs. 760,000+ direct beneficiaries. First stage at 80% completion. Timeline cut from 6 years to 3.

🇲🇽✊ "When you govern with honesty and without corruption, the resources reach the people." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Teapa, Tabasco Rosario Méndez Jiménez, elderly pension beneficiary, described how the support lets her provide food for her family — recognizing a lifetime of work finally met with a government that sees her.

🇲🇽✊ 708,000 people in Tabasco receive federal welfare programs or pensions — 24.4 billion pesos invested in 2026 alone. — Leticia Ramírez Amaya, Secretary of Welfare Sheinbaum personally delivered pension cards to elderly residents in Teapa. Tabasco's poverty rate dropped 22% under the 4T.

🇲🇽🌎 Sheinbaum announces May 31 accountability report — broadcast simultaneously from plazas in all 32 states. "Celebrate the victory, defend the people's conquests, and defend sovereignty." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Teapa, Tabasco Two years since the 4T's electoral landslide on June 2, 2024. Not a centralized rally — a nationwide address from every state capital.

🇲🇽✊ "Mexico is not anyone's colony. We are not anyone's protectorate." "Mexico — with great honor, great pride, and through hard work — is a free, independent, and sovereign nation." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Teapa, Tabasco Sheinbaum addressed thousands during a welfare tour across Tabasco. Banner behind the podium: "La patria se ama y se defiende."

🇲🇽🇵🇸 FRANCE BANS BEN GVIR FROM ITS TERRITORY — FLOTILLA FALLOUT GROWS

French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot announced Israel's Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir is now banned from entering France over what Barrot called "unqualifiable acts against French and European citizens" aboard the Global Sumud Flotilla.

Poland imposed a 5-year entry ban. Spain is pushing EU-wide sanctions. The UK summoned Israel's top diplomat in London. Among the 500 flotilla passengers: 50 hospitalized, 35 with fractures, 5 injected with unknown substances, and 15 reported sexual assault.
